chapter: Bucktown, Chicago and the cabaret years
title: First cabaret job at Bucktown with Manuel Mineta's band
summary: Her first nightclub job was in Bucktown, singing Dardanella with Manuel Mineta's band. They try to recall the other players, including Amos White on cornet and Zip on clarinet.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Where was your very first job working as a featured entertainer with a band?

Well, it's like I'm telling you, in the concerts, you see, when I was small, it was not, they never said about featured, they just had the show and all of us kids went on. But the first cabaret job, the first time I ever worked in a nightclub was right here in New Orleans out in Bucktown for Martins. And a friend of mine was playing out there in a band and he just asked me to take a ride out there and I did. And when he introduced me to the band boys, he told them how I could sing. So Manuel Mineta was the leader of this orchestra. Oh, I know that band. Well, and he said to me, well, come on, we can play anything you can sing. So I said, okay, then, let's go on Dardanella. And they played Dardanella and I sang Dardanella and I got the job that night.
Who was in the band? Who else?

Well, now I see, there was Manuel Mineta and there was, um, I can't, I can't, I think, I think Carrie Fritz was the, I think Carrie was the cornet player. And, um, they had a cornet, I think banjo or guitar, I'm not sure, I can't remember so well. But, um, I think there was a piano, either banjo or a guitar, cornet, Amos White was playing the cornet. He's now in Oakland, California, Amos White, cornet player. He was cornet and they had drums and trombone and manual on the piano.
Yes, I think, yes, and the clarinet player, oh, I can't remember his name.
I think so, I think that's right, Zip. That's right, that's true, that's right, Zip.
I've heard prof speak about it, I used to think from prof.
He had a good old band, uh, they used to have Rene with him at one time.
Well, no, Rene wasn't with him at that time. I think it was, uh, Carrie, Carrie Fritz, I think, was with him at that time.

Yeah, but I mean, uh, I didn't buck down, he used to have Rene with him, he said. That's right, that's right. With Zip. But this band didn't have any trombone, I remember. Yeah. Mineta was playing piano with it?
That's right, Mineta was playing the piano.
He's a wonderful musician, he can play anything.
